text:
- yad idaṃ vibhavātmakaṃ bhuvanajātam uktaṃ garbhīkṛtānantavicitrabhoktṛbhogyaṃ — this world-born glory-natured, wombing endless varied enjoyer-enjoyed. [tsa-a08-v01] (R) [CLM-001]
- tatra yad anugataṃ mahāprakāśarūpaṃ — what pervades as great-light-formed. [tsa-a08-v01] (R) [CLM-002]
- tat mahāsāmānyakalpaṃ paramaśivarūpam — that is like the great common, Supreme-Śiva-formed. [tsa-a08-v01] (R) [CLM-003]
- Paramaśiva = what pervades the whole as great light. [tsa-a08-v01] (R) [CLM-004]
- yat tu katipayakatipayabhedānugataṃ rūpaṃ tat tattvam — what pervades only some differences: a category. [tsa-a08-v02] (R) [CLM-005]
- yathā pṛthivī nāma ... samastabrahmāṇḍānugatā — as earth, pervading all world-eggs from Kālāgni to Vīrabhadra. [tsa-a08-v02] (R) [CLM-006]
- Partial pervasion defines tattva; earth the example. [tsa-a08-v02] (R) [CLM-007]
- citprādhānye śivatattvam — awareness-led: Śiva. [tsa-a08-v16] (R) [CLM-008]
- ānandaprādhānye śaktitattvam — bliss-led: power. [tsa-a08-v16] (R) [CLM-009]
- icchāprādhānye sadāśivatattvam — will-led: Sadāśiva. [tsa-a08-v16] (R) [CLM-010]
- Five principles by power-primacy; will as even-acceptance. [tsa-a08-v16] (R) [CLM-011]
[tantrasara-a08:tsa08-p01]
